title: Kick acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a = 300 m/s² using a = (v_final - v_initial)/Δt with v_initial = 0.

title: Air time calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes t = 0.4 s using t = distance/velocity with distance = 12 m.

title: Velocity change magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly finds |Δv| = 40 m/s, accounting for direction reversal (v_after = -10 m/s relative to initial direction).

title: Goalkeeper acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a = 400 m/s² using a = Δv/Δt with proper sign handling.

title: Acceleration definition application
description: Important: Uses average acceleration formula a_avg = Δv/Δt for both contact periods.

title: Direction consideration
description: Important: Recognizes velocity as a vector and accounts for direction changes when computing Δv.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s, m/s²) throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in Δv
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for direction reversal, computing Δv = 20 m/s instead of 40 m/s.

title: Incorrect time formula
description: Pitfall: Uses kinematic equations with acceleration for air time instead of constant velocity formula.
